overloadMerges.note: title, object, hide, size, repeatedValue, displayFormat and resultVar are all documented with the '←' arrow (values returned by the command), not '→'; auto-parse defaulted all of them to direction 'in'.

params.name: colNum
params.description: Number of the column to inspect

params.name: title
params.description: Title displayed in the column header (meaningless in cross-table mode)

params.name: object
params.description: Field name or formula assigned to the column

params.name: size
params.description: Column size in pixels; negative means automatic size

params.name: repeatedValue
params.description: 0 = values not repeated, 1 = values repeated (meaningless in cross-table mode)

params.name: resultVar
params.description: Name of the variable ("C1", "C2", ...) automatically assigned by the Quick Report editor to a formula column, if any

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Retrieves the display and data-source parameters (title, field/formula, visibility, size, repetition, format, and formula-result variable name) of an existing column identified by colNum in a Quick Report area; in cross-table mode, title/hide/repeatedValue are meaningless and colNum's meaning for size vs. data source/format differs (see cross-table numbering in the docs).

constraints: In cross-table mode, the title, hide, and repeatedValue parameters are meaningless, and the numbering used for colNum differs between retrieving the column size and retrieving the data source/display format.
Does not take into account any virtual structure defined via SET TABLE TITLES / SET FIELD TITLES: object always returns the actual field name.
